scientific_values: Current WSPRadar calculations from frozen raw provider reports; expected_* files are assertions only
pipeline: current generated SQL -> reference_sql.execute_generated_sql over source_rows.csv
adapter_limit: SQLite executes the generated scientific SELECT, predicates, grouping and aggregation through a bounded ClickHouse-function adapter; this is not native ClickHouse verification

presentation.B: Coarse paper-style rebinning of production 1 dB histogram counts; external digitized paper bars overlaid
presentation.C: Native production Joint-Spot histogram renderer, with unchanged bins, percentage heights, colours, median and mean; white paper-export theme
presentation.display_precision: One decimal place for mean and sample standard deviation; at most two decimal places for other calculated display values; residuals use a coefficient times 10^-4 per dB; original paper and arXiv identifier unchanged
presentation.axes: Linear axes; native Panel C limits and tick policy retained
presentation.legend: Separate legends centered below Panels B and C, with panel-scoped labels; native red dashed median retained
presentation.sample_standard_deviation: Supplemental paper-review statistic: NumPy standard deviation with ddof=1 over actual production paired differences; this is not a statistic supplied by the app histogram recipe
presentation.sample_standard_deviation_label: Sample σ, following the paper's symbol for its estimated sample standard deviation; reconstruction still uses ddof=1
